title: Stationary hitting times on vertex-transitive graphs
summary: We prove a refined version of the Aldous and Brown's exponential approximation of stationary hitting times. These are valid for all reversible Markov chains. We then specialise our estimates for vertex-transitive graphs, where we obtain improved bounds which depend on the growth of the graphs. The most delicate cases are when the diameter is comparable to that of low-dimensional tori. In particular, in "dimensions" less than four (up to logarithmic factors) our error terms are the square of those of Aldous and Brown.
